assets.alt_text: Six-plane governed development architecture. Authority and canonical knowledge feed coordination, followed by execution, delivery, and continuity, with verified evidence returning to the knowledge layer.

assets.post_copy:
Start with evidence, not a product story.

Governed Codex accepts Markdown, text, PDFs, or an exact public Git commit. It preserves file hashes or repository/ref/commit/tree/blob lineage before Core reviews candidates and the user approves any canonical claim.
assets.post_timing: Publish after the architecture overview and before owner-scoped orchestration.
assets.alt_text: Markdown, text, PDF, and exact commit-pinned Git sources move through immutable intake, candidate organization, Core review, and user-approved promotion into canonical documents; unaccepted material remains evidence.
Owner-scoped development cycle: Sol plans and controls authority, Terra implements the approved packet, Luna independently verifies the exact commit, and Core integrates the primary branch.

assets.post_copy:
Multi-agent systems often fail at the boundary, not the model.

Governed Codex owners do not edit one another's domains. They publish atomic A2A requests with evidence, an exact need, an owner disposition, and completion proof.

Disagreement stays visible. Authority stays scoped.
assets.post_timing: Publish immediately after the owner-scoped orchestration post.
assets.alt_text: Agent-to-agent boundary protocol. A requesting owner freezes evidence and asks for a public contract through an immutable A2A record. The responsible owner challenges assumptions and accepts, narrows, defers, or rejects it. Only accepted verified contracts proceed to Core integration.

Governed PDF research flow. Exact PDF bytes are preserved, Core asks before installing the pinned parser, native text is extracted page by page, and OCR, encryption, or empty-page limits stay explicit.

assets.post_copy:
PDF intake should never blur unsupported states.

supported → process native text
dependency_unavailable → ask before install
no_extractable_text → preserve the empty result
encrypted → stop without requesting passwords

Exact source bytes remain evidence in every case.
assets.post_timing: Publish immediately after the conceptual governed-PDF-research post.
assets.alt_text: Terminal PDF intake receipt showing four explicit outcomes. Supported content records an exact source hash. Dependency unavailable reports the missing approved parser and requires approval before installation. No extractable text preserves an empty page diagnostic without OCR. Encrypted input stops processing without requesting or storing passwords.
Efficient testing lifecycle. Focused, cached-failure, affected, and broad checks support development, followed by one parallel-safe full phase and one isolated serial phase on the final candidate.

assets.post_copy:
Five pytest profiles. One lifecycle.

focused → current surface
failed → cached failures
affected → Git impact map
broad → bounded regression
full → parallel-safe + serial isolation

Terra debugs narrowly. Luna verifies the final candidate once.
assets.post_timing: Publish immediately after the conceptual test-lifecycle post.
assets.alt_text: Terminal command reference for five governed pytest profiles: focused tests one current surface and stops immediately; failed reruns cached failures; affected maps a Git diff to tests; broad runs conservative regression with a three-failure limit; full runs the registered parallel-safe phase followed by exclusive serial tests.

Portable owner continuity. A completed task exports bounded transcripts, receipts, and decisions to Git so another device, fresh task, or authorized employee can rehydrate and verify the same owner role.
Governed Codex Bootstrap header with the tagline: Research to evidence to approval to delivery to continuity.
